root_idea.summary: The root centers on moving onward, passing along, and flowing.
root_idea.development: From movement and progression it extends to a way or mode of proceeding, a state or condition, and causative movement. The sense of a thong or stripe is explained through extension and stripe-like form.

senses.definition: To go, move along, travel, proceed, or depart.
senses.usage_conditions: Used of persons and other moving subjects. With بِـ, it can mean to travel or proceed with someone; Quranic usage includes ordinary travel and movement away.

senses.definition: To cause someone or something to go or move; to set in motion, convey, or move away.
senses.usage_conditions: The Quranic use includes deliberate enabling of travel as well as movement imposed by command, force, or subjugation; passive forms describe things caused to move.
A verbal noun referring to the act or course of moving or traveling; Quranic contexts include a journey and a forceful movement.

senses.definition: A traveling company, caravan, or group of travelers.
senses.usage_conditions: In Quranic usage it denotes a group on the road, not a modern motor vehicle.

senses.definition: The state, condition, or form in which something is; its former or original state.
senses.usage_conditions: In the Quranic occurrence, the expression refers to the object's previous condition, rather than to a way of conduct or a biographical narrative.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To sail or move along, said specifically of a ship.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A tropical extension of ordinary going or proceeding.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To pursue or follow a way, course, or manner of conduct.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used in expressions describing good or bad conduct or a way of acting.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To become current or customary among people; to cause a saying or practice to become usual.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of proverbs, sayings, ways, or practices that circulate or are established socially.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To make someone or something go, proceed, or depart.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A transitive Classical use synonymous with سَيَّرَ and distinct from the ordinary intransitive Quranic use.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To remove a covering or horsecloth from an animal.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A tropical use applied to taking a cloth or covering off a horse or other beast.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To make a proverb or saying current; to publish it among people.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A causative social extension of movement or circulation.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To relate stories of the ancients.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A conventional narrative use.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To mark or make stripes upon cloth, a garment, an arrow, or a dye pattern.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The stripes are conceived as thong-like bands.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To go with someone, keep pace with him, or run alongside him.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Form III expresses accompanying or matching another's rate of movement.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To vie, contend, or compete with someone in going or running, and by extension in an affair.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative extension from competing in movement.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To peel or strip off and become like thongs.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Said of a man's skin when it peels into strip-like forms.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To go at an equal rate, keep pace, or run together.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used reciprocally of two parties moving in coordination.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To have assertions or statements agree with one another.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An idiomatic figurative use based on two things running together consistently.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To vie, contend, or compete with one another, in movement or more generally.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A reciprocal extension of keeping pace.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To depart or disappear gradually, said of anger.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An idiomatic use describing anger leaving the face by degrees.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To pursue one's way, course, mode, or conduct.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A derived use referring to following a chosen manner of acting.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To procure wheat or other provisions from a place for storage.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The object is provision obtained for subsistence and laid up in store.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A thong, strap, or strip of skin or leather.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: This is a concrete nominal distinct from the verbal noun of going; its plural forms include سُيُورٌ and أَسْيَارٌ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A mode or manner of going or proceeding.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A nominal extension of movement, distinct from the Quranic sense of state or condition.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A way, course, rule, or manner of conduct or life.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Equivalent in Classical usage to a person's or ruler's established method of acting.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The record of a person's actions and pious works.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An understood record or written account is associated with the term.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Stories or accounts of the ancients.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A narrative use, including accounts referred to as the stories of earlier peoples.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The mention of a person or thing, or a matter under discussion.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A later figurative or discursive use.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Military expeditions, their memorable actions, or their affairs.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A technical legal and historical plural use, as in works on military expeditions.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Wheat or other provisions brought from a place to be stored.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized nominal use concerning provisions for subsistence.

other_classical_meanings.definition: One who goes or journeys much; a great goer.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Also used as an epithet for a hackney or an ass.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A striped garment or cloth, especially a striped or silk-mixed textile.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The name is associated with stripe-like bands or thongs; descriptions vary as to the precise textile.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The diaphragm or midriff.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative anatomical use.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The peel or pellicle adhering to a date stone.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized botanical use.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A palm branch stripped of its leaves.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A concrete botanical use.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Gold, especially clear or pure gold.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized nominal use reported in Classical lexicography.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A certain plant resembling the خُلَّة.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A rare botanical designation.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The five visible planets: Mercury, Venus, Mars, Jupiter, and Saturn.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative astronomical plural usage distinct from the Quranic traveling company.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A proverb or saying that is current or commonly known.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative participial use derived from circulation among people.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The rest or remainder of a thing; according to some usage, the whole or all of a thing or people.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The lexical evidence records both interpretations; the remainder sense is the primary reported one here.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A place or time of going or journeying.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A derived nominal use of مَسِيرٌ beyond its basic verbal-noun function.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Travelled or traversed, as of a road; made to go or journey, as of a person.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A passive-participial use with forms such as a travelled road or a person made to journey.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A distance or journey measured by the time required to traverse it.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used in expressions such as a day's or month's journey.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Striped or patterned with stripe-like bands; a striped garment, cloth, or eagle.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The textile use commonly concerns silk or silk-mixed cloth; the same descriptive formation is applied to a striped eagle.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A particular well-known sweetmeat.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized lexicalized noun.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A place from which wheat or other provisions are procured for subsistence and storage.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: One reported interpretation derives it from اِسْتَارَ; another interprets the cited form as referring to the journey itself.

lane_unit_coverage.note: Ordinary going, journeying, proceeding, and departure.
Pursuing a good or bad way of conduct.
A saying or proverb becoming current.
A practice or way becoming customary.
Making a way or practice customary.
Going with or keeping pace with another.
Verbal-noun use of going is covered by the Quranic verbal-noun sense.
Explicitly identified as a substantive related to going.
Peel adhering to a date stone.
Participial and cross-reference notation adds no independent lexical branch.
Remainder, with an attested alternative whole/all sense.
Inflectional identification as a verbal noun adds no separate lexical meaning.
Travelled road or person made to journey.
Journey measured by time or traversed distance.
Striped eagle, covered by the broader stripe-pattern sense.
Provision-procuring place, with a reported alternative journey interpretation.

cautions: سَيَّارَةٌ in the Quranic and Classical evidence means a traveling company or caravan, not the modern noun for an automobile.
سِيرَةٌ has several Classical branches, including conduct and narrative uses; its Quranic occurrence here is specifically the sense of state or condition.
The entry for مُسْتَارٌ preserves a reported lexical alternative between a provision-procuring place and a journey.
